author_or_account: Laura Hanson Schlachter, PhD / U.S. Census Bureau
title: Evaluating Nonresponse Bias in CPS Data
discussion_signal: The post calls attention to the possibility that survey nonresponse biases income and poverty statistics and treats methodological review as part of the public evidence system. The signal is institutional: what the public can know about hardship depends partly on who answers and how agencies correct the record.
linked_research_question: How do survey participation and nonresponse change the social groups visible in public measures of income, poverty, and security?
limits: The post points to methodological work rather than presenting all adjustment results
Nonresponse bias may vary by measure and year
A methodological concern does not quantify the direction of every estimate
